_about: Official figures for Ontario universities, which the US College Scorecard doesn't cover. Copied by hand from the sources below on 2026-09-13; update them when new reports are published.
notes: Earnings, related-field employment, graduation, and experiential learning use the same Ontario government definitions for both schools (2020-2025 Strategic Mandate Agreement metrics, 2023-24 results).

Tuition isn't measured the same way: Waterloo's computer science figure is for September 2026 entry and includes incidental fees; Toronto's is 2025-26 tuition only. Toronto computer science students pay the general Arts & Science fee in first year ($6,100 domestic), then $11,420 from second year.
